dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: The rules-context-loader completed successfully with schema validation and consistent prompt versioning, and conversation-to-aw plus alignment-engine also completed with schema_validation_success. However, two downstream spans failed: architecture-work-to-evolution-map hit an authentication error, and architecture-intent-generator failed structured output parsing. These failures show that governance and execution controls did not preserve an error-free orchestration run, reducing governance quality despite correct rule-context loading.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: conversation-to-aw and alignment-engine succeeded, providing partial cause-effect traceability from conversation to alignment. However, architecture-work-to-evolution-map failed before completing the architecture-to-evolution causal map, and architecture-intent-generator failed structured output parsing. These failures break the intended causal chain from intent generation through evolution mapping, leaving causal reasoning incomplete.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: The alignment-engine produced a schema-valid report with substantial reasoning token volume, suggesting trade-off analysis occurred during alignment. However, the architecture-intent-generator and architecture-work-to-evolution-map failures remove key inputs and outputs needed to surface, compare, and resolve architectural tensions end-to-end. Semantic inspection of the alignment report is not available in the trace metadata, limiting confirmation of trade-off resolution quality.
